title: Read the project brief
sub: Span, design vehicles, deflection limit, budget — and the engineering idea behind the project

title: The site: a 10 m creek
sub: The red triangles are anchors — fixed foundations. Your bridge connects them.

title: Choose Road deck
sub: Click it in the Tools panel, or press 1. Vehicles can only drive on the deck.

title: Drag to build the deck
sub: Drag from the left anchor. Panels are max 3 m long, so build five 2 m panels, joint to joint.

title: Choose Timber
sub: Press 2 — light, cheap glulam. Pick a section in the left panel.

title: Add triangles under the deck
sub: Drag from each deck joint down 1.5 m to make V shapes — triangles cannot change shape

title: Read the analysis
sub: Utilisation: how hard each member works under the factored design load (green → red)

title: Inspect a member
sub: Press V (Select) and click a member

title: Run the load test
sub: Press Load test (Space). Real vehicles cross; members break if overloaded.

title: Results and stars
sub: ★ safe crossing · ★ code compliant · ★ efficient (≤ 80% of budget)

title: The Playground
sub: Free testing: unlimited budget, traffic, driving, loads and earthquakes

title: Drive it yourself
sub: Click Drive (or click any vehicle) and use ← → to drive

title: Drop heavy loads
sub: Choose a weight, then click above the deck

title: Earthquake
sub: Shake the ground and watch how the structure responds
